controles.affirmation: La hausse des allocations "traduit l'extension progressive du groupe vers des prets a des operateurs plus petits et non cotes (Great Wolf, Canyon Ranch, Club Med notamment)"
controles.verbatim_source: Les moteurs primaires listes par le 10-Q sont : "(i) the initial CECL allowance of $72.6 million upon completing the acquisitions of the Gamehost Portfolio and Golden Portfolio, (ii) an increase in the estimate for the Long-Term Period PD for one of our tenants as a result of the tenant issuing new senior secured debt with a lower credit rating than our prior estimate, and (iii) negative changes in the macroeconomic forecast".
